title: docs(changeset): correct the objectql release note for the set-rooted predicate delete walk

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_
Fixes #27201

Clause-②: yes (widening) — unchanged from the landed changeset; the review 6466053903 found the line right and this card keeps it.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:改正 `@objectstack/objectql` 待发布说明 `.changeset/27004-predicate-delete-walk-as-set.md` 里三处与代码不符的说法,并加一条测试钉住其中一项行为。引擎代码一行未动。
- **为什么改**:这份 changeset 会在 Version Packages(#26517)合并时变成 objectql 的 CHANGELOG;合并后复核(6466053903)判定其中三句失实,必须在发版前改正。
- **风险与回滚**:只改发版说明文字与一个测试;发布级别 `patch` 和两行声明保持不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR,说明退回旧的错误文本。
- **先看**:① `.changeset/27004-predicate-delete-walk-as-set.md` 新增的三条要点和 `Clause-②:` 行里改过的例子;② `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts` 新增的一条用例。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts`,预期 20 条全过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。`Check Changeset` 对只改现有 changeset 的 PR 按设计保持红(非必需检查,不打 `skip-changeset`),改正的书面确认由席位写在本 PR 上。

## What changes

The pending changeset of #27073 (card #27004) becomes the `@objectstack/objectql` release note when Version Packages (#26517) lands. The post-landing contract review of #27073 (comment 6466053903) found the engine right and three statements of the note false. This PR corrects those statements and changes nothing else in the note: the `patch` level, the title, the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` declarations, and the Before, Now (one qualifier added) and Who-sees-it bullets stay.

1. **By-id probe filters.** The note listed "the filter of every probe a by-id delete sends" as unchanged. That is gone from the Unchanged bullet. A new bullet, "A by-id delete's probes, too", states what changed. `collectCascadeDeleteSet` probes the records found at one depth together, per object and relation, and `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade` probes together the members asking one relation. With two or more records this sends `$in`, one probe per 500 records, or on a multiple lookup the OR of each id's `$contains` (`referenceProbeFilterOfSet`). The root's own probe and each cascaded child's own walk still send that one record's filter: a batch of one is `referenceProbeFilter`, and a child is deleted through its own by-id `delete()`, which joins the set and walks one id.
2. **Two outputs the note left out.** Each has its own bullet now:
   - A matched row that another matched row's cascade reaches is now removed by the predicate delete's own id-set `deleteMany`. The set walk enters every matched id before the first nested `delete()`, so the cascade skips it. The count the predicate delete returns now includes that row, and its `beforeDelete`/`afterDelete` hooks fire once, from the per-row dispatch. Before, the cascade's nested `delete()` removed the row ahead of `deleteMany`, so the count left it out, and its hooks fired a second time from that nested delete. The new bullet also notes that a flow's `delete_record` hands this count on as its `result` (`crud-nodes.ts`).
   - Which refusal is reported. The set walk asks each relation about every matched row before it moves on to the next relation. It also runs the own-cascade `restrict` check for every matched root before the walk starts. So when two relations refuse different matched rows, it reports the first relation's refusal. Before, it reported the first matched row's refusal.
3. **The example.** The `Clause-②:` line said the row-by-row walk refused a report and its manager (a `restrict` self-lookup, both matched) "or not, depending on which row it met first". It refused in either order, and the line now says so. The `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration at the start of the line is unchanged.

The Now bullet's "`cascade` deletes (each child through its own delete, hooks and all)" now says "each child the predicate did not match". Without that qualifier it would contradict item 2.

## Tests

- New in `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts`: *counts a matched row another matched row cascades into, and fires its delete hooks once (#27004)*. An object holds a `cascade` lookup to itself, and parent and child are both matched. The test asserts the delete returns `2`, only the unmatched row is left, and each matched row gets exactly one `beforeDelete` and one `afterDelete`. This is the optional pin the card offered.
- Before writing a sentence, I measured each before/after claim in the new text once, against the old per-row predicate arm. The arm's single `cascadeDeleteRelations(object, matchedIds, …)` was swapped for the loop it replaced, one root per matched id, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The mutation landed (blob `3dcaaed4af74` → `b887e2f85237`) and was restored to HEAD (`git diff HEAD` empty). Temporary probe cases were appended to the test file and removed afterwards; the file's blob equals HEAD.

| Reading (in-memory test driver) | Set walk (this tree) | Old per-row walk (mutation) |
|---|---|---|
| Cascaded matched row: count returned | `2` | `1` |
| Cascaded matched row: its hooks | before ×1, after ×1 | before ×2, after ×2 |
| Report + manager, `restrict` self-lookup, manager matched first | deleted (`2`) | `DELETE_RESTRICTED` |
| Same, report matched first | deleted (`2`) | `DELETE_RESTRICTED` |
| `aa_guard` restricts p2, `zz_guard` restricts p1 | refuses p2 via `aa_guard` | refuses p1 via `zz_guard` |

The new pin test fails on the mutation (`expected 1 to be 2`) and passes on this tree.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Check Changeset` stays red, by design.** This PR edits a pending changeset and adds none, so the job reds twice: its count of added changesets is 0, and `check-empty-changeset.mjs` refuses a change to a changeset that exists on the merge base. This is that gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class. The route it prescribes: do not restore the note, do not apply `skip-changeset`, name the note and what changed under it on the PR, and get the correction confirmed there in writing. The note is `.changeset/27004-predicate-delete-walk-as-set.md`. What changed under it is the engine change #27073 already landed: this PR changes no code, and the note was wrong about that change from the start. The order for this edit is the card's triage ruling (6467217349), verbatim: "⛔ Edit the pending changeset text only. The engine code was judged right." The written confirmation on this PR is still owed. `Check Changeset` is not one of the ten required contexts.
- The note must land before #26517 is merged; that is the card's deadline.
- No engine code changes. `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` is byte-identical to `origin/main`.

## Verification

All readings are from the worktree of this branch. Head is `cbc268d7` unless a line says otherwise.

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 59 derived, 59 run, 58 exit 0, 1 exit 1 (by design)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 59 families at `cbc268d7` from 2 changed paths (+38/-3).
- I ran each one and recorded its exit code. The `--ran` reconciliation reads: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- The one non-zero exit is `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` (exit 1). It names `.changeset/27004-predicate-delete-walk-as-set.md` as existing on the merge base and offers the DELIBERATE CORRECTION route. See Acceptance notes.
- The first run, at `00ca77b4`, had three exit-3 readings: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (a shallow clone; I fetched its pinned control commit), `check:lean-entry-closure` (needed objectql `dist`; I built it) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needed built packages). All three exit 0 in the `cbc268d7` run.

</details>

<details><summary>@objectstack/objectql package runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0. Output: `check:test-typecheck: OK … 39 file(s) / 233 error(s) / 64 pinned signature(s) held`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` at `00ca77b4`: `Test Files 477 passed (477)`, `Tests 8900 passed (8900)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. The only commit after it (`cbc268d7`) changes two lines of the changeset, so `packages/objectql` is byte-identical.
- `vitest run src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts`: 20 passed. Under the old-walk mutation, the new case fails with `expected 1 to be 2`.

</details>

<details><summary>Not run locally</summary>

- `pnpm lint` over the whole repo: CI runs it. I ran `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts` on the one code file this PR touches: exit 0, no findings.
- `test:repo`: CI runs it, and the diff touches no file of that project.
- Full dogfood: not owed. The title carries no `!`, and the `Clause-②:` line carries no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
